access_a_role_is_a_set_of: A role is a set of permissions. Changing one changes it for everyone who holds it.
access_delete_x_their_empty_spaces_go: Delete {{username}}? Their empty spaces go too. Spaces with documents must be transferred or deleted first.
access_people_on_this_server_roles_and: People on this server, roles, and server permissions. Permissions on single spaces are set in each space's sharing dialog.
access_the_newest_changes_to_permissions: The newest changes to permissions, shares, keys and accounts. This list can't be edited.
access_who_may_do_what_on_this: Who may do what on this server. These never give access to documents.
admin_allow_public_and_drop_links_which: Allow public and drop links, which work without an account
admin_backup_kinds: A full backup holds everything: people, teams, spaces with trash and all versions, tags, collections and keys. A differential backup holds the same information but only the files added since the last full backup; restoring needs the full backup and the newest differential.
admin_backup_location: Backups stay on the server; copy them elsewhere from the file system.
admin_backup_location_dir: Backups stay on the server in {{dir}}; copy them elsewhere from the file system.
admin_backup_restore: Restoring is done on the command line: {{command}} into an empty server, with the same {{secret}}.
admin_delete_the_tag_x_it_is: Delete the tag {{name}}? It is removed from every document on this server.
admin_delete_the_x_backup_x_the: Delete the {{mode}} backup {{backup}}? The file is removed from the server.
admin_no_tags_yet_tags_are_added: No tags yet. Tags are added on documents, in the details of the preview or viewer.
admin_one_tag_list_for_the_whole: One tag list for the whole server. Everyone can create tags; only administrators rename, merge or delete them. Usage counts cover your own spaces only.
admin_saved_how_many_full_backups_are: Saved how many full backups are kept
admin_search_now_uses_the_existing_ocr: Search now uses the existing OCR text
admin_some_pdfs_arrive_as_scans_that: Some PDFs arrive as scans that someone else already ran OCR on. tildoc keeps that text and additionally removes it to run its own OCR on the plain images. Choose which text search and the text view use for these documents.
admin_storage_backups_and_background_pro: Storage, backups and background processing for the whole installation. Administrators cannot open other people’s spaces.
admin_turning_this_off_stops_all_existin: Turning this off stops all existing public and drop links at once.
c_delete_the_collection_x_the_documents: Delete the collection “{{collection}}”? The documents in it stay where they are.
c_deleted_the_collection_its_documents_a: Deleted the collection. Its documents are unchanged.
c_documents_included_through_the_tag_sta: Documents included through the tag stay until the tag is removed from them.
c_for_importing_into_a_tildoc_server: For importing into a tildoc server, with versions and tags
c_select_documents: Select documents in any folder and choose “Add to collection”.
c_select_documents_or_tag: Select documents in any folder and choose “Add to collection”, or include a tag under Edit.
c_the_documents_you_can_see_as: The documents you can see, as a ZIP archive
collectionform_no_tag_only_documents_add: No tag (only documents added by hand)
collectionform_team_members_see_the_docu: Team members see the documents of it they already have access to.
collectionpicker_you_have_no_collection_: You have no collection you can add to yet.
docdetails_delete_version_x_for_good_it: Delete version {{version}} for good? It can't be brought back, and a restored backup won't bring it back either.
docdetails_embedded_directly_in_the_file: embedded directly in the file, no OCR needed
docdetails_identical_content_is_stored_o: Identical content is stored only once. In another space it is a separate document, so a new version there does not change this one.
docdetails_restored_version_x_as_the_cur: Restored version {{version}} as the current version
docdetails_same_content_own_versions_and: same content, own versions and tags in that space
docdetails_some_pages_have_no_text_layer: Some pages have no text layer. OCR has not run yet because the worker has no OCR tools.
docdetails_text_extraction_is_not_availa: Text extraction is not available for this file type.
docdetails_this_document_was_split_off_f: This document was split off from another one when it was changed through one of several places (copy-on-write).
docdetails_uploaded_a_new_version_every_: Uploaded a new version. Every link shows it.
docview_no_preview: There is no preview for this type.
docview_no_preview_download: There is no preview for this type. The file is stored unchanged and can be downloaded.
docview_no_preview_for_this_format_open: No preview for this format. Open it to view and edit.
docview_open_in_office_right_now_changes: Open in Office right now. Changes become a new version when everyone has closed it.
f_confirm_trash_one: Move {{count}} item to the trash? Documents that also appear elsewhere (links) stay available there.
f_confirm_trash_other: Move {{count}} items to the trash? Documents that also appear elsewhere (links) stay available there.
f_drop_files_here: Drop files or whole folders here, or press <kbd>{{key}}</kbd> to upload. Folder structure is kept.
f_folders_keep_their_structure_files_tha: Folders keep their structure. Files that are already stored are only added as another place.
f_import_a_zip_or_a_tildoc: Import a ZIP or a tildoc export into this folder
f_move_back_to_where_it_was: Move back to where it was imported
f_moved_back_to_the_original_import: Moved back to the original import location
f_nothing_has_been_added_here_yet: Nothing has been added here yet.
f_this_folder_with_all_subfolders_as: This folder with all subfolders as a ZIP archive
filetable_open_in_office_a_new_version: Open in Office. A new version follows when everyone has closed it.
historygraph_history_versions_and_their_: History: versions and their variants, oldest first
historygraph_scan_with_an_existing_ocr_l: scan with an existing OCR layer
home_you_have_no_spaces_yet_create: You have no spaces yet. Create one under Spaces.
imageview_this_image_can_t_be_displayed: This image can't be displayed. Download it to open it in another program.
importdialog_files_imported_before_the_p: Files imported before the problem stay where they are.
importdialog_hint_folder: A tildoc export (.tildoc) or a ZIP file. Folders are kept; files that are already stored here are not stored again.
importdialog_hint_space: A tildoc space export (.tildoc) from this or another server. It becomes a new space with its folders, versions, tags and collections; files that are already stored here are not stored again.
importdialog_optional_lowercase_letters_: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
importdialog_x_files_x_of_them_already: {{files}} files, {{deduplicated}} of them already stored, {{folders}} folders.
importdialog_x_new_documents_x_joined_do: {{documents}} new documents, {{merged}} joined documents that were already here, {{places}} places, {{collections}} collections. {{blobs_existing}} files were already stored and not stored again.
importdialog_you_can_close_this_window_t: You can close this window; the import continues on the server.
layout_group_documents_from_several_spac: Group documents from several spaces, for example all bills for your tax return.
login_the_sign_in_could_not_be: The sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
login_your_account_is_waiting_for_approv: Your account is waiting for approval by an administrator. Sign in again once it is approved.
officeview_changes_are_saved_automatical: Changes are saved automatically and become a new version when you close the document.
officeview_this_document_can_t_be_opened: This document can't be opened in Office
officeview_version_x_arrived_from_elsewh: Version {{version}} arrived from elsewhere. When this session ends, its text becomes the current version and version {{version}} stays in the history.
pdfview_download_it_to_open_it_in: Download it to open it in another program.
pdfview_the_file_is_not_a_valid: The file is not a valid PDF.
permhelp_audit_view: See who changed permissions, shares, keys and accounts.
permhelp_download: Get the file itself: download, WebDAV, SFTP, S3 and copying it elsewhere.
permhelp_drop_in: Create a Drop-In token: a key that scripts and devices use to send files into this space, and nothing else.
permhelp_export: Export whole folders or the space as a ZIP or bundle.
permhelp_manage: Rename the space, change its settings, and delete it once it is empty.
permhelp_move: Move files and folders out of this space into another one.
permhelp_purge: Delete from the trash for good, empty the trash, and delete single old versions for good.
permhelp_roles_manage: Change roles and who holds server permissions.
permhelp_settings_manage: Change server settings, see statistics and start processing again.
permhelp_share_file_login_link: Make a link to a single file that works only for people signed in to tildoc.
permhelp_share_file_people: Share a single file with people and teams, without giving access to the rest of the space.
permhelp_share_file_public_link: Make a link to a single file that works for anyone who has it, without an account.
permhelp_share_space_drop_link: Make a link where anyone can upload into this space, without seeing what is in it.
permhelp_share_space_login_link: Make a link to the whole space that works only for people signed in to tildoc.
permhelp_share_space_people: Add people and teams to this space and set what they may do.
permhelp_share_space_public_link: Make a link to the whole space that works for anyone who has it, without an account.
permhelp_spaces_recover: Give a space a new owner, for example when someone left. Does not allow reading it.
permhelp_tags_manage: Rename, merge and delete tags for everyone.
permhelp_teams_manage: Change any team, also without being a member.
permhelp_transfer: Hand the whole space to another owner.
permhelp_users_manage: Add, change, disable and delete people on this server.
permhelp_view: See the files, read them in the browser and search them. Nothing more: without Download the file itself is not handed out.
permhelp_write: Upload, create and edit files and folders, add new versions, tag, and move within the space.
quicksearch_finds_words_inside_documents: Finds words inside documents, including scanned pages after OCR. Use quotes for an exact phrase and a minus sign to exclude a word.
quicksearch_no_documents_match_search_wi: No documents match. Search with filters
s_you_can_add_files_here_you: You can add files here. You cannot see what is already there.
search_try_fewer_or_different_words_scan: Try fewer or different words. Scanned PDFs become searchable once OCR has run.
settings_a_drop_in_token_sends_files: A Drop-In token sends files into one space and can do nothing else. The space must allow it in its settings.
settings_api_keys_help: For programs using the REST API: {{header}}. A key can only do what you tick here, and never more than you can do yourself.
settings_changed_your_password_sign_in_a: Changed your password. Sign in again with the new one.
settings_choose_which_viewer_shows_pdfs_: Choose which viewer shows PDFs in the preview and in the full-window viewer.
settings_connect_from_dolphin_on_arch_li: Connect from Dolphin on Arch Linux
settings_copy_the_command_now_the_token: Copy the command now. The token is shown only this once.
settings_copy_the_key_now_it_is: Copy the key now. It is shown only this once.
settings_copy_the_secret_now_it_is: Copy the secret now. It is shown only this once.
settings_each_top_level_folder: Each top-level folder is one of your spaces. Copying a file that is already stored only adds another place for it; overwriting a file creates a new version.
settings_for_s3_clients_key_id_and: For S3 clients (key ID and secret) and as the password for WebDAV and SFTP. Your account password never works for these. A key can be limited to one space, and to reading only.
settings_no_access_keys_yet: No access keys yet. Create one to connect Dolphin, rclone or another client.
settings_pdfs_now_open_in_the_browser: PDFs now open in the browser’s own viewer
settings_pdfs_now_open_in_the_tildoc: PDFs now open in the tildoc viewer
settings_rclone_install: Install with {{command}}, create an access key, add the config shown afterwards, then mount:
settings_revoke_access_key_x_clients_tha: Revoke access key {{k_id}}? Clients that use it stop working right away.
settings_revoke_api_key_x_programs_that: Revoke API key {{k_id}}? Programs that use it stop working right away.
settings_search_inside_the_document_with: Search inside the document with highlighted hits, jumps from search results to the right page, page thumbnails, and switching between the original and the OCR version. PDFs are drawn inside tildoc with scripts in the PDF turned off.
settings_sign_in_to_sftp_with_a: Sign in to SFTP with a key instead of an access key secret.
settings_the_pdf_viewer_of_your_browser: The PDF viewer of your browser, with its own printing and form filling. No highlighted hits and no page jumps from search results. PDFs are then shown without tildoc’s sandbox, so the browser’s own protections apply.
settings_type_into_dolphin_s_location_ba: Type into Dolphin’s location bar. The password is an access key secret.
settings_uses_a_registered_ssh_key_or: Uses a registered SSH key, or an access key secret as the password.
settings_your_profile_how_documents_open: Your profile, how documents open, and the keys that file managers and sync tools use to connect.
setup_this_works_only_while_no_account: This works only while no account exists. The administrator manages people and processing; their documents stay private like everyone else’s.
shared_nothing_has_been_shared_with_you: Nothing has been shared with you yet.
shared_single_files_other_people_gave_yo: Single files other people gave you access to.
sharedialog_copy_this_command_now_the_to: Copy this command now, the token is shown only once:
sharedialog_copy_this_link_now_it_is: Copy this link now, it is shown only once:
sharedialog_drop_link_others_can_only_up: Drop link: others can only upload
sharedialog_for_scripts: For scripts and devices: sends files in and can do nothing else. It is listed under Settings, where it can be revoked.
sharedialog_for_scripts_folder: For scripts and devices: sends files in to the folder {{folder}} and can do nothing else. It is listed under Settings, where it can be revoked.
sharedialog_links_are_off_for_this_space: Links are off for this space. They can be enabled in its settings.
sharedialog_no_links_can_be_made_here: No links can be made here.
sharedialog_owner: The owner always has every permission. Permissions only add up: someone gets everything their own row and their teams' rows give.
sharedialog_owner_team: The owner (managers of team {{team}}) always has every permission. Permissions only add up: someone gets everything their own row and their teams' rows give.
sharedialog_select_the_command_and_copy_: Select the command and copy it
sharedialog_select_the_link_and_copy_it: Select the link and copy it
sharedialog_uploads_land_at_top: Uploads land in the top of the space. Visitors see nothing that is already there.
sharedialog_uploads_land_in_folder: Uploads land in the folder {{folder}}. Visitors see nothing that is already there.
spaces_a_space_holds_folders_and_documen: A space holds folders and documents, for you alone or for a team, and can be shared with more people. Its short name is the S3 bucket and the top folder in WebDAV and SFTP.
spaces_all_current_files_as_a_zip: All current files as a ZIP archive
spaces_delete_the_space_x_this_only: Delete the space “{{confirm}}”? This only works when it contains no documents.
spaces_everything_incl_versions_tags_and: Everything incl. versions, tags and collections, to import into a tildoc server
spaces_only_empty_spaces_can_be_deleted: Only empty spaces can be deleted later.
spacesettings_keys_that_scripts_and_devi: Keys that scripts and devices use to send files into this space, and nothing else.
spacesettings_links_that_work_for_anyone: Links that work for anyone who has them, without an account. The server must also allow them.
spacesettings_links_where_anyone_can_upl: Links where anyone can upload into this space without seeing what is in it. The server must also allow them.
spacesettings_nobody_the_owner_included_: Nobody, the owner included, can upload, edit, move or delete anything here, by any channel, until this is switched off.
spacesettings_saved_the_settings_of_the_: Saved the settings of the space
spacesettings_sharing_single_files_with_: Sharing single files with people and teams.
spacesettings_tildoc_adds_no_ocr_version: tildoc adds no OCR version and no image-only variant to files here. Originals are never changed, and text already in a file stays searchable.
teams_a_team_shares_spaces_roles_decide: A team shares spaces. Roles decide what each member may do in the team’s spaces.
teams_also_owns_the_team_s_spaces: also owns the team's spaces and manages the team
teams_delete_the_team_x_this_only: Delete the team {{current}}? This only works when its spaces contain no documents.
teams_gets_what_the_team_has_on: gets what the team has on each space
teams_name_of_the_new_team_space: Name of the new team space
teams_pick_a_team_to_see_its: Pick a team to see its members and spaces.
teams_you_are_not_in_any_team: You are not in any team yet.
texteditor_arrived_meanwhile: Version {{version}} arrived meanwhile ({{source}}). Saving makes yours the newest; it stays in the history.
texteditor_arrived_meanwhile_by: Version {{version}} arrived meanwhile ({{source}}, {{by}}). Saving makes yours the newest; it stays in the history.
texteditor_changes_against_the_version_y: Changes against the version you opened. Saving creates version {{next}}.
texteditor_ctrl_f_search_and_replace_alt: Ctrl+F search and replace, Alt+↑/↓ move lines
texteditor_is_editing: {{name}} is editing this document. You see their saved versions live and can edit once they are done.
texteditor_saved_meanwhile: Version {{version}} was saved meanwhile. The changes below are against that version. Saving makes your text the newest version; version {{version}} stays in the history.
texteditor_saved_meanwhile_by: Version {{version}} was saved meanwhile by {{by}}. The changes below are against that version. Saving makes your text the newest version; version {{version}} stays in the history.
texteditor_saved_meanwhile_by_via: Version {{version}} was saved meanwhile by {{by}} via {{source}}. The changes below are against that version. Saving makes your text the newest version; version {{version}} stays in the history.
texteditor_saved_meanwhile_via: Version {{version}} was saved meanwhile via {{source}}. The changes below are against that version. Saving makes your text the newest version; version {{version}} stays in the history.
texteditor_text_files_larger_than_5_mb: Text files larger than 5 MB are shown read-only.
texteditor_this_document_is_being_edited: This document is being edited elsewhere now. Your unsaved changes are still here; copy them if you need them.
texteditor_this_file_is_not_utf_8: This file is not UTF-8 text; it is shown read-only so its characters are not damaged.
texteditor_you_are_editing_this_document: You are editing this document in another window.
texteditor_you_can_edit_this_document_no: You can edit this document now
texteditor_you_can_read_this_document_bu: You can read this document, but not change it.
texteditor_your_text_equals_the_newest_v: Your text equals the newest version; nothing to save
textview_showing_the_first_2_mb_of: Showing the first 2 MB of {{size}} MB. Download the file to read all of it.
transferdialog_the_new_owner_gets_every_: The new owner gets every permission at once. This cannot be undone by you unless you keep a role that allows it.
trash_a_document_lands_here_when_its: A document lands here when its last place is deleted. It stays until the date shown, then it is deleted for good. Restoring recreates missing folders.
trash_delete_every_document_in_the_trash: Delete every document in the trash of {{space}} for good? This can't be undone.
trash_delete_x_and_all_its_versions: Delete “{{name}}” and all its versions for good? This can't be undone.
trash_deleted_documents_appear_here_unti: Deleted documents appear here until they are removed for good.
view_a_new_version_follows_when_you: A new version follows when you leave the editor
view_scanned_pages_are_only_searchable_i: Scanned pages are only searchable in the version with OCR text.
